name: devfreq_list
desc: 列出全部devfreq动态调频设备与频率
cmd: for d in /sys/class/devfreq/*; do echo "== $d =="; echo -n 'cur='; cat $d/cur_freq 2>/dev/null; echo -n 'min='; cat $d/min_freq 2>/dev/null; echo -n 'max='; cat $d/max_freq 2>/dev/null; echo -n 'gov='; cat $d/governor 2>/dev/null; done 2>/dev/null | grep -i -- $filter | head -80
